description: Land Title Settlement Department - Udaalndeniya, Udunuwara D/S Division, Kandy District - Cad. Map No. 320237 and others
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels (Parcels 103, 15, and 50) with detailed information about land ownership, extent, location, and title classification. The content focuses entirely on land registration and property ownership matters, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it involves land titles, property ownership determinations, and cadastral mapping information.
